adds.title: Acre Law No. 3,355 (19 December 2017, Governor Tião Viana)
adds.summary: Acre Law No. 3,355 of 18 December 2017, published 19 December 2017 with entry into force 60 days after publication, guarantees all natural persons use of their nome social — the name by which they recognize themselves and are recognized socially — in all acts, registrations, records and forms of the state's direct and indirect public administration, requires indication of civil-registry first name and chosen social name at registration or attendance, obliges state servants to address the person by the indicated name in written acts while restricting civil-registry name to internal use accompanied by the social name and prohibiting pejorative expressions, requires both names on formal documents such as official letters, summons and notifications, mandates servant training, treats non-compliance as a functional infraction subject to administrative liability and sanction, and assigns dissemination to the State Secretariat of Justice and Human Rights.

adds.title: Supreme Federal Court ruling of 1 March 2018
adds.summary: On 1 March 2018 the Supreme Federal Court in ADI 4275 held that the right to equality without discrimination encompasses gender identity and expression and permitted alteration of name and gender in the civil registry without sex-reassignment surgery or judicial authorization, requiring the State to recognize self-declared gender identity as a manifestation of personality.

adds.title: 2025 first 'X' gender marker case - Ariel Sebastos
adds.summary: After a 2-year process via the Defensoria Pública do Estado do Acre initiated circa 2023, judge Luana Cláudia de Albuquerque Campos granted 46-year-old Sena Madureira native Ariel Sebastos Nascimento Silva the first Acre civil-registry rectification to "sexo não binário" with a 48-hour compliance order to the Sena Madureira cartório still pending transfer in late June 2025 and no physical rectified documents yet issued, while DPE/AC with the Secretaria de Estado da Mulher scheduled the "Viver com meu nome" name-and-gender rectification mutirão for 28 June 8h-13h at the Defensoria with OCA certificate issuance 24-26 June requiring RG/CPF, passport if any, voter title, proof of address and negative state, federal, electoral, labor and military if registered male certificates plus health, social and electoral services.

adds.title: SEASDH-MPAC cooperation agreement and booklet (29 January 2025)
adds.summary: On 29 January 2025 Acre's SEASDH and MPAC signed a Technical Cooperation Agreement to protect LGBTQIAPN+ dignity and launched the booklet 'O que voce precisa saber sobre os direitos da populacao LGBTQIAPN+: Mudanca de nome e genero de pessoas Trans e Travestis' guiding trans and travesti people through legal name and gender rectification with required documents and steps and through access to health services, education, employment and humanized non-discriminatory care with planned wide distribution via public bodies and civil society and MPAC oversight to enforce public policies and maintain essential services including the trans outpatient clinic; 2024 saw no recorded trans deaths in Acre, while prejudice-driven exclusion from dignified work with many without fixed income dependent on social programs and school evasion limiting progression to higher education remain identified challenges.

adds.title: Rio Branco Law No. 2389 (30 December 2020, Mayor Socorro Neri)
adds.summary: Enacted 30 December 2020 and in force on publication (5 January 2021), Rio Branco prohibits any discrimination based on sexual orientation or gender identity and punishes violent acts and discriminatory acts against homosexuals, bisexuals, travestis or transexuals including prohibiting entry or stay in any public or private establishment open to the public, selective service not required by law, denying or surcharging hotel/motel/pension lodging, denying or surcharging rental/purchase/lending of movable or immovable property, restricting access to public transport such as buses and taxis, denying school enrollment, and inciting discrimination/violence via any media/publication, with liability for individuals and for-profit or non-profit legal entities in the municipality and penalties of warning, fine set by municipal regulation, suspension of activities/operating license up to 30 days, and interdiction/cassation graded by gravity and recidivism and economic capacity, open to complaint by any resident with guaranteed confidentiality if requested.
